content:
**Dirty Laundry** is a quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

To start this quest, the Vault Dweller has to pick up any case Abraxodyne Intel. They can be found at any and all of the below locations:

| Image | Location |
| | On Highway 35, north of Checkpoint Canyon, next to the giant Welcome to Ohio Sign in the broken trunk of a rusted car. |
| | At the Railroad Service Yard, one is on the top floor of a small brick building under a desk. Another is in a corrugated metal barn on a shelf. A third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. |
| | At the Railroad Service Yard, another is in a corrugated metal barn on a shelf. A third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. |
| | At the Railroad Service Yard, a third can be found in the bigger brick building in an office that overlooks the building on a desk. |
| | At an unmarked water tower southwest of the Railroad Service Yard, one can be found on a wooden platform on the tower. |
| | At an unmarked water tower southwest of the Railroad Service Yard, another is at a small seating area next to the water tower, under a picnic table with corrugated metal on top of it. |
| | Going south of the unmarked water tower and following the train tracks, one can be found at the end where a wrecked train is toppled over. |
| | At the Meadow Breeze Storage Depot, one is inside a tank trailer. The other is in a large wooden shed near some barrels. |
| | At the Meadow Breeze Storage Depot, another is in a large wooden shed near some barrels. |
| | Jackson Junkyard has one in a broken down wooden shack that has the Admin Terminal inside. |
| | Jackson Junkyard has another that can be found at the top of the hill in the back of a truck that is partially falling down the slope. |
| | Slightly East of the Jackson Junkyard, one is in a shopping cart by a small rocky overhang turned into a makeshift camp. |
| | Going North of the Jackson Junkyard there is a small unmarked brick building that has an intel case under the table. |
| | One can be found at the Abraxodyne Chemical Power Substation in the corrugated metal shack. |
| | One can be found at Sand Fork Lumber inside a broken down shed with crafting benches inside. It is next to the Weapons Workbench. |
| | Southeast of Sand Fork Lumber there is an unmarked dry farmland with a skeleton holding the case while partially submerged in the dirt. |
| | Southeast of The Rust Kingdom there is an unmarked house on a trailer trying to go through a tunnel at the end of the road. Inside the collapsed tunnel there is one case inside a rusted car. |
| | Four can be found at Tycoon Lake. One in the shed of the Abraxodyne pump station at the top of the hill, which also gives the Vault Dweller the Meadow Breeze Sprayer. |
| | At Tycoon Lake, another is in a metal camper on the North side of the lake. |
| | At Tycoon Lake, one is in the same truck as the Note to Manny, on the west side of the lake on the road. |
| | The last one at Tycoon Lake is up the dirt road leaning against a wooden log next to a motorcycle. |
| | Two can be found at Fort Steuben. One can be found propped up against the Fort Steuben sign. |
| | At Fort Steuben, the other is near an Eastern entrance behind a wall of sandbags. |
| | South of Fort Steuben, in a small sitting area with a concession stand there is an intel case under the table with two skeletons. |
| | South of Fort Steuben in an unmarked covered bridge there is one in the back of a rusty van. |
| | Two at Westbrook Horse Ranch. One inside the barn, and the other under the front of the most southern Horse Trailer. |
| | At Westbrook Horse Ranch, the other is under the front of the most southern parked Horse Trailer. |
| | One can be found at Albany in the same white house with a red door that has the Abraxodyne Cache inside. It is on the top floor on a metal shelf. |
| | One at The Chop Shop, inside the Red Rocket, underneath a counter. |
| | One at The Chop Shop, inside the Red Rocket, at the bloodied garage. |
| | One at The Chop Shop, at a nearby makeshift shooting range south of the trailer home, leaning against a wooden crate. |
| | One can be found inside the Oak Hill unmarked Cathedral North of the Chop Shop, in the back left side on a shelf. |
| | One can be found North East of Oak Hill in an unmarked destroyed house on top of a set of stairs. |
| | Three can be found at Starlight Drive-In. One is the concession stand of the Starlight Drive-In, on the landing of the stairs between the first and second floor. |
| | At the Starlight Drive-In, another is located on the shelf of a small metal shed behind the projector screen. |
| | The third is case at the Starlight Drive-In is on the Attack of the Fishmen Billboard, which can be accessed by climbing the fallen tree that landed on it. |
| | Two can be found at Prospect Hill. One held by a skeleton next to a bench near some red viewfinders. |
| | The other at Prospect Hill is inside a metal trailer in a safe with no door. |
| | One can be found at the bottom of the hill of Honey Well Apiary, in the planter box next to the shed. |
| | Two can be found Hocking Hills Station. One is inside the building, on a bench next to some take-out containers. |
| | The other at Hocking Hills Station is on the East side of the station, in a tipped over orange train car. |
| | Going North of Hocking Hills Station, there is one in a collapsed car tunnel. |
| | Two can be found South of the Hocking Hills Station. One in a Nuka-Cherry themed bathroom on the ladies side. |
| | The other South of Hocking Hills Station is in the dugout of the baseball diamond. |
| | Going even farther South of Hocking Hills Station, one can be found in a doghouse next to an unmarked building. |
| | One can be found halfway between Hocking Hills Station and the World of Corn, in a locked shed behind a metal camper. |
| | On top of a hill Southwest of the above locked shed unmarked location, there is a rusty hollowed out van that has one case in the back. |
| | West of the World of Corn, one can be found under a playground. |
| | South of the World of Corn, there is a fallen down tree with an intel case hidden underneath. |
| | One can be found inside the building at the World of Corn in a room marked "Employees Only." It is under the desk that has the World of Corn Administrator Terminal on it. |
| | One can be found at Sandy's Sock Hop behind the counter with the broken soda machines. |
| | Two can be found at the Ash Cave. One can be found at the top of the hill of the near the ramp of a windmill. |
| | Before entering the Ash Cave, there is a small Ash Cave Hocking Hills Station, with an Intel case next to a Nuka-Cola Machine near the bathroom. |
| | The other at the Ash Cave is at the bottom of a hill just outside of a metal shack next to some barrels. |
| | One can be found at Shade Hill Church, being held by a skeleton in a pew. |
| | One can be found inside the Super Duper Mart on a shelf with some pre-war food. |
| | Two can be found Southwest of Dino Peaks Mini Golf in some unmarked buildings. One is in the bathtub of the basement of a run down building. |
| | The other case that is Southwest of Dino Peaks Mini Gold is between the legs of a skeleton sitting on the porch of a small cottage. |
| | Three can be found at Dino Peaks Mini Golf. One is behind the Dino Diner, in a dumpster. |
| | Another Intel Case in Dino Peaks is west of Hole 5, in a shed. |
| | The third Intel case that is located in Dino Peaks is in the small "FOOD" concession stand, to the right of Hole 8. |
| | One can be found East of the Dino Peaks Mini Golf on top of a hill, in a small white unmarked church. |
| | One can be found North of Dino Peaks Mini Golf in a red unmarked shed near a small house with a porch. |
| | One can be found farther North of Dino Peaks Mini Golf at the end of the railroad line, inside the collapsed tunnel. |
| | One can be found West of Dino Peaks Mini Golf at the unmarked Pebbles the Cat Museum in the employees only shed. |
| | One can be found North of the Pebbles the Cat Museum inside an unmarked white train tower next to the desk. |
| | One can be found on an upturned boat, at the northernmost part of the map, at the unmarked body of water. |
| | Seven can be found at or around Athens. One can be found just before the south entrance to Athens in a red storage container along the road. |
| | Continuing with Athens, one can be found by crossing the red bridge with railroad tracks on it to a small island with a cottage. It is leaning up against the cottage with some crates. |
| | One can be be found behind the Athens Armory in a metal shack between two shelves. |
| | Near a brick "PUB" building in Athens, an Intel case is held by a skeleton on the side of the building next to an Abraxo advertisement. |
| | Crossing the bridge near the above Intel case, one can be found inside a building which can be entered through a hole in the wall. Taking a right, the case is in the kitchen on the counter. |
| | One is across the street from the Abraxodyne Office on the "Welcome to Athens Halloween!" stage in the back. |
| | Behind the Abraxodyne Office there is a basketball court where a case can be found leaning up against a lamp post. |
| | Ten can be found at Highway Town, four outside and five inside. Starting outside, one can be found under the highway, floating in the water. |
| | On the broken piece of the highway ramp going up there is a black limo hanging off the edge. Inside is a skeleton holding the Intel case. |
| | Going inside, one can be found on the second floor of Scrap Go, behind a password locked door. The door can be opened using the code 1867. |
| | One can be found inside a small room on the second floor, North of the Port-A-Diner. |
| | One can be found behind Splint's Guns shop , in a small back room under a shelf. |
| | Another can be found right down the stairs of the entrance to the Underbelly, on the immediate right hand side. |
| | In the Underbelly one can be found on the right in a blue storage container near an exit that leads out to Appalachia. |
| | On the outside level of Highway Town, on the very top layer there is an Intel on a shelf to the right of a yellow camp stove and radio in a makeshift bar area. |
| | On this same outside level, an Intel case can be found in a room with a Poker game set up, next to a "Girls, Girls, Girls" poster on a wooden shelf inside of a winding wooden shack. |
| | In a metal camper with a door labeled "Security Gate" that has a basketball hoop above it, an intel can be found on the metal shelf. |

After picking up any Intel case, the Vault Dweller can travel to Athens and enter the Abraxodyne Office where they will meet Bodhi. Bohdi is searching for these Intel cases in order to find out more information about his daughter, Amrita, who has gone missing. Bodhi will offer you rewards, including the Abraxodyne Tapes, for the more Intel cases you bring him. On Abraxodyne Tape 10, Vault Dweller will start to receive the radial locations of the Abraxodyne Caches.

| Image | Location |
| | One can be found at the top of the tower of Fort Steuben. |
| | One can be found at Dino Peaks Mini Golf, next to the volcano at Hole 5. |
| | One can be found at Albany in a white house with a red door. This is the same location as the Abraxodyne Intel in Albany. It is on the second floor in the corner. |

Once the Vault Dweller receives the Abraxodyne Tape 15 Bodhi will reveal that a hitman was sent to kill Amrita, who was a whistleblower on Abraxodyne's Meadow Breeze project, and asks you to go the apartment where the hitman was supposed to collect their gear for the assassination. Entering the trap littered apartment, the Vault Dweller meets The Exec, who is a ghoulified former member of Abraxodyne Chemical's board. He admits to having Amrita assassinated and can either offer the Vault Dweller caps to keep quiet or can be killed.

The Vault Dweller can return to Bodhi and tell him of The Exec's fate, in which he will choose to no longer stay at Athens. Before he leaves he shows the Vault Dweller how to open and decrypt the Abraxodyne cases themself.
